viewing_check: Confirm the star after both serial numbers is on the note itself and matches the K/82 prefix, check folds, tears, pinholes, repairs and edge nicks, and photograph both sides in good light. Ordinary 1942 notes sell for only A$15 to A$45, so the whole value rests on the star being genuine.
